why-clip-report.json is the REAL output of Ryagram's tools/why_this_clip.py (branch why-this-clip efff8936, NEXT-BUILDER 48, schema ryagram.why-clip/0, run with --json) on why-clip-draft.json, a SYNTHETIC five-clip edit list made up for this test (made-up people Ann, Bob, Cy, Dee, Eve and made-up file names; it covers the five ways a take is chosen: own, fit, forms, alias, cast-fallback with a speed limit and a voice-unsure flag). No real film, person or library was read.
